title: What Scripture Actually Says About Being Ready for a Wife (It's Not What You Think)
caption:
You think you're not ready for a wife because the job isn't set, the body isn't finished, the plan isn't done. Scripture was never grading that list.

The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control (Galatians 5:22-23). Every trait a woman actually wants in a husband is already on it. None of it comes from a gym log or a job offer. It comes from walking with God long enough that it starts to show.

So stop auditing yourself. Give Him your mornings, your obedience, your attention. He isn't waiting on your resume. He's waiting on your surrender.

This week: open your Bible before your banking app. Confess the one thing you've been managing instead of killing. Show up faithful on the ordinary Tuesday nobody's watching.

The man worth marrying was never trying to look ready. He was just close to God.

theme: He chases God, not a wife.
